spanish: Y todo vestido y toda piel que fuere sobre él yacimiento de semilla, y será lavado en las aguas, y se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה עָלָיו שִׁכְבַת־זָרַע licenses the lying-of-seed as what is upon the garment/skin; the 3ms suffix resumes that garment/skin. “que fuere sobre él” makes the garment/skin what is upon another masculine singular and leaves “yacimiento de semilla” off that predicate.
findings.spanishSpan: que fuere sobre él yacimiento de semilla

findings.issue: H7902 is the noun lying/layer, not a place. In current Spanish “yacimiento” is a deposit site; only an archaic sense is the act of lying.
Qal 3ms licenses be/become unclean. “se impurecerá” is inchoative smoothing, and the pronominal can be read as a reflexive the qal does not mark.

notes: Plural “las aguas,” pual “será lavado,” and “semilla” for זֶרַע stay inside the tokens.
